sources.title: LEAP-LAB-KUS/leap-kt-bkt3-2020-12 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: BKT3 — Part of leap-kt-toolkit, a systematic re-implementation of published Knowledge Tracing models under one protocol. This repository holds every fold of every dataset this model has been run on, with the per-epoch training logs and the exact user split alongside the checkpoints.
